name: Hridaya Family

location.city: Bochojbo Alto, near San Cristobal de las Casas

tradition: Non-Dual Shaiva Tantra (Hindu-tantric yoga) with Advaita Vedanta and Buddhist influences
technique: Silent meditation retreats, dark-room retreats, somatic/embodiment practice
teacherAccess: Daily group sits and talks during retreats, facilitator-led
retreatOptions: 3, 6, 7, 10, 12, and up to 30-day silent retreats; solitary retreats also offered
about: A dedicated, owner-built retreat property in pine forest at 2,200m altitude, on land regarded locally as a Mayan sacred site. Houses a 100 sqm meditation hall, a main house, and two cabins for around 22 guests. Meditation is the structural center of the flagship 'Silent Meditation Retreat' line, though the broader Hridaya brand also runs yoga-teacher-training and somatic programs.
schedule: Multiple silent retreats scheduled through the year in recurring 3/6/10-day cycles
cost: 10-day retreat: course fee $320 + accommodation from $110 (dorm, 11 nights) + meals $145

pricePerDay.notes: 10-day retreat, budget dorm tier, all-in per night.

foodNotes: Three meals a day included in package.
